title: Wald Inference over Growing Causal Windows for Convex Matrix Completion with Dependent Noise
banked_reason: D0.5.G: incremental, ceiling 3.2 below the field floor 7.4; the headline native-optimizer transfer and fitted-stability derivations remain unreproduced and the framing is not salvageable in scope.
gap_reasons: the headline native-optimizer inference theorem is not proved
the neighborhood-coupling estimate (6), centered-aggregate equations (3)/(8), and fitted curvature/weight equations (5)/(9) lack checkable derivations
The calibration inherits the unproved transfer theorem and there is no completed reproducible application.
On the results actually supported, this is a collection of useful setup lemmas rather than a field-level inference contribution
proof_attempt_summary: The discovery run derived the proximal fixed-point identity, the three-block first differential, auxiliary-fit measurability, and score-diffuseness, and it verified the two cited source theorems. The native masked-optimizer second-order transfer, centered higher-order aggregation, fitted Hessian/weight stability, and the resulting uniform Wald expansion were not reproduced at a checkable level, leaving only an incremental setup package below the field floor.
tldr: For a deterministic common-start missing block, the native one-missing-cell convex optimizer has a complete three-block tangent score and a serial rank-projection drift. Neighborhood replacement through the native fixed point, centered quadratic aggregation, residual finite-lag covariance estimation, and fitted Hessian and weight stability yield feasible uniform scalar Wald inference whenever \(\psi_{\min,\mathrm{loc}}\ge\omega_n\sqrt n\,\ell_n^2(\ell_n+H^{1/4})\) with \(\omega_n\to\infty\). This is a sufficient envelope, not a sharp frontier.
gap: Deterministic-MNAR panel completion has weak-signal inference only under independent errors and small one-date subgroups. Dependent-noise PCA, residual HAC for missing factors, and analytic bias correction for unbalanced interactive-effects regression do not control the implemented masked convex completion estimator at the shrinking standard-error scale of a growing causal window.
fill: The project supplies a local-signal-indexed native expansion, a feasible Hessian--lag covariance correction defined in the same target chart as each auxiliary fit, an influence-weighted residual covariance estimator, a dependency-graph central limit theorem derived from conditional block dependence and factor-geometric score diffuseness, and uniform Wald coverage. A separate exponent-indexed class poses the sharp signal--cohort--window frontier without building a sufficient remainder envelope into its assumptions.
